## About
Hello, I'm Nickey Bishop. I am an arborist, and The Tree Tender is my tree service here in Austin. Austin tree care is my focus, though I work in the surrounding area too. I like to be considered a tree doctor. I studied Botany in college and have been working in the trees for decades.
Mine is a small business and I plan to keep it that way. Keeping it small lets me manage the crew, make sure everything is done safely, and see that the work is done right to the smallest detail. In a nutshell, we climb trees to do what is necessary to help the trees.
Please, do not ask me to kill a living tree. I do not have the heart for it. But if you want someone to care for your trees in the best possible way, give me a call. The Tree Tender holds a 5 rating from 61 Google reviews.

## Services
- Class 2 pruning: Every limb pruned all the way to its end, taking care of everything but the little twigs.
- Thinning and shaping: Thinning and shaping the canopy so the tree keeps a healthy form.
- Cabling and bracing: Support work for trees that need help holding their limbs.
- Cavity treatment: Treatment for cavities in the tree.
- Ball moss removal: Clearing ball moss from your trees.
- Dead limb and mistletoe removal: Taking out dead limbs and mistletoe.
- Diagnostics and consultations: Nickey looks at what is going on with your trees and talks with you about how to care for them.

## FAQ
Q: Do you remove trees?
A: No. Nickey does not have the heart to kill a living tree, even when it truly does need to be done. His work is caring for trees.

Q: Do I have to make a decision right away?
A: No. Nickey never asks for a decision. He leaves you a copy of the proposal, and the choice is strictly yours.

Q: Can the work be spread out to fit my budget?
A: Yes. We can tend all your trees at once or do them in stages over time at your convenience.

Q: I'd like to do my own tree work. Can you help?
A: Call Nickey first. He will give you a few pointers on making proper selections and cuts, plus some safety tips, at no cost to you.

Q: When can I reach you?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
